coupling: The lossless decoder commit changes VP8LGetWindowRows from an amortized 2x window to its calculated minimum; its lossless callers still retain the needed history and copy headroom. The later alpha-window commit uses that shared helper with only one history row, relying on the former 2x slack to accommodate the 24 rows delivered by the final filtered macroblock. Together they allocate 24 rows while the alpha path needs the preceding row plus 24 output rows. A correct repair must reconcile the helper sizing contract with the alpha caller's maximum batch and retained row; changing only the lossless or alpha algorithm in isolation misses the cross-commit assumption.
